{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "effective_approval_reconstruction",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the final response correctly reconstruct the effective approval outcome for all four BNSSG 2025-Q3 proposals by using the latest non-withdrawn approval step rather than trusting the proposal header alone?",
      "pass_anchor": "It must cover CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0058, CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0117, CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0149, and CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0186. The first three have no approval_step rows in the supplied database, so their effective step-level approval is not evidenced even though compensation_proposals.approval_status says approved. CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0186 has three steps; sequences 1 and 2 are withdrawn and sequence 3 is an unwithdrawn approved People and Culture step dated 2025-09-26, so its effective latest non-withdrawn decision is approved. The response must distinguish displayed header status from step-level evidence and must not call the first three fully step-verified without qualification."
    },
    {
      "id": "four_target_pay_rows",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the response report the four proposal-to-post target-pay decisions with the correct band, step, target basic pay, and pay gap?",
      "pass_anchor": "The four rows must identify: CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0058 / POST-BNSSG-CLINICAL-SUPPORT-05 / Band 5 TOP / target 370000000 pence / gap +10000000 pence; CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0117 / POST-BNSSG-ALLIED-HEALTH-06 / Band 6 INTERMEDIATE / target 400000000 pence / gap +13000000 pence; CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0149 / POST-BNSSG-PROGRAMME-MANAGER-07 / Band 7 TOP / target 200000000 pence / gap +7000000 pence; CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0186 / POST-BNSSG-EXECUTIVE-08A / Band 8a PROTECTED / target 41498280 pence / gap -2775360 pence. Currency conversion to GBP is acceptable only if numerically equivalent."
    },
    {
      "id": "withdrawn_chain_and_tracker_linkage",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the response accurately identify the withdrawn intermediate approval chain and reconcile proposal task keys to the implementation tracker without inventing a linkage?",
      "pass_anchor": "It must identify CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0186 as the proposal with withdrawn intermediate approvals, with withdrawn line-manager sequences 1 and 2 followed by the unwithdrawn sequence-3 approval. It must report the substantiated Workday task keys TASK-BNSSG-COMP-100001-100068, TASK-BNSSG-COMP-100069-100141, and TASK-BNSSG-COMP-100142-100180 for the first three proposals, and state that CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0186 has implementation_task_key NULL/no task key in Workday. It may reconcile the tracker only at the supported programme level: the tracker covers 186 substantive employees and records Band 5=68, Band 6=73, Band 7=39, Band 8a=6; it does not expose those Workday task-key strings. It must not claim the tracker contains the missing task key."
    },
    {
      "id": "protected_pay_treatment",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the response correctly interpret the protected Band 8a proposal and the meaning of its negative gap?",
      "pass_anchor": "For CP-BNSSG-25Q3-0186, the response must state transition_treatment protected_pay and target step PROTECTED, and explain that the -2775360 pence gap reflects current basic pay above the model target/protected placement; it is not an instruction to cut current pay. It should distinguish protected-pay treatment from standard placement and should not fold allowances or enhancements into the target basic-pay figure."
    },
    {
      "id": "no_workspace_change",
      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_no_workspace_change",
      "description": "The read-only audit leaves the supplied workspace evidence unchanged and available.",
      "weight": 0
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "import hashlib\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\nTRACKED = (\n    \"02_Working_Model/bnssg-afc-harmonisation-model-sep-2025.xlsx\",\n    \"04_Executive_Pack/bnssg-harmonisation-implementation-tracker-sep-2025.xlsx\",\n)\n\n\ndef _fingerprint(path):\n    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef check_no_workspace_change(ws):\n    \"\"\"Sanity-only check for this read-only audit task.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        root = Path(ws)\n        ok = all((root / rel).is_file() and (root / rel).stat().st_size > 0 for rel in TRACKED)\n        return {\n            \"score\": 1.0 if ok else 0.0,\n            \"detail\": \"controlled model and tracker remain present and readable\",\n        }\n    except Exception as exc:\n        return {\"score\": 0.0, \"detail\": f\"workspace sanity check failed: {exc}\"}\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "both",
  "act": "none",
  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}

rationale: Zero reward weight for rules measured passing on pristine state; keep the checks and failure reports.
